scientific_integrity: The general one-point type factorization is earlier work; only the all-size inverse classification and minimal ambiguity are assessed as the retained result.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to parameter metrics with distance 1 within nonempty classes and distance 2 between classes in the unrestricted {1,2,3}-Urysohn space; not to arbitrary graphs/metrics. The inverse uses Bang-Zsigmondy; originality is provisional, and no independent mathematical audit has occurred.
title: Mersenne rigidity of one-point types over clustered diameter-three metric bases
